item.text: The first Galaxy validation exposed a parameter-encoding issue before submission; the BAM and tool are valid. I’m correcting the conditional-input representation and will rerun the same scientifically defined filter.

Galaxy completed the second call, but its provenance check shows the conditional controls were ignored and defaults were used, so I’m discarding that output. I’ll use the tool’s legacy parameter encoding to ensure the proper-pair and MAPQ filters are actually applied.
